note: Family campground on the ridge top, a short hike from the Kickapoo valley overlook. Only sites 3, 8, 10-12 and 28-30 are sized for large trailers; 2, 5 and 23-27 take small trailers, and the rest are tent or van sites. Twenty cart-in tent sites, the 24-site horse campground (northeast of the office) and the group camp are separate. Steep access roads up the ridge. --Claude
summary: DNR camping page + 2019 family campground map read: 25 drive-in sites (1-16, 22-30), electric 22-30, flush + vault toilets, showers, water, dump; all reservable. Only 8 sites sized for large trailers (3, 8, 10-12, 28-30), 7 for small trailers. Stored count 30 -> 25. Not waterfront kept; pin ~170 m from the loop, kept. GTC fees/lengths unread.
